claims.summary: Observed: the astrid:llm marker scanner is deterministic; scan_known_model_control_markers (L114) preserves a marker's bytes only when reference_syntax is Some, distinguishing quoted ("TOKEN"), grouped ((TOKEN)), and explicit-relation (TOKEN behaves) contexts.
claims.disposition: verified_existing. Complete source (L18-521) at report-bound SHA 902a0358 confirms it: ExactKnownMarkerReferenceContext enum (L41-46) has the three named variants; reference_syntax (L49) tries exact_reference_delimiter_syntax then followed_by_explicit_exact_token_relation; scan (L114) pushes occurrence.token into remainder only when reference_syntax.is_some() (L129-131). Covered by scan_known_model_control_markers_preserves_grouped_and_explicit_relation_contexts (tests.rs L3133).

claims.summary: Snag: first_word_after (L89) matches a hardcoded relation-verb allowlist (L66-85). A novel valid relation verb (e.g. TOKEN triggers) is not recognized, so the marker may be stripped/mishandled.
claims.disposition: verified_existing, concern preserved. The allowlist is a closed matches! set of exact literals (L64-86); an unlisted verb -> reference_syntax None -> not preserved -> stripped as none_cleanup_candidate. This is the intended conservative fail-safe (strip an unreferenced control marker), not an accidental mishandle. Her underlying concern (a legitimate mention using a novel verb loses the token) is a real, deliberate tradeoff, grounded by passing regressions for triggers (L2881), acts (L2603), implies/contains/creates/underscored (L2836-2908).

claims.summary: Test 1 (Relation Recognition): pass a marker followed by a verb not in L66-85 (e.g. TOKEN initiates) and verify reference_syntax returns None, ensuring the explicit-relation logic does not over-generalize.
claims.disposition: verified_existing. Because the allowlist is an exact-literal matches! set, it cannot over-generalize; an unlisted verb returns None. Her example 'initiates' is not in L67-84 and is functionally identical to already-tested unlisted verbs. Covered by control_marker_cleanup_does_not_expand_relation_allowlist_to_triggers (L2881), distinguishes_allowlisted_is_from_unlisted_acts (L2603), uses_only_the_first_finite_relation_word (L2640) — each asserts removed_total=1, preserved=0, reference_syntax=none_cleanup_candidate. A literal 'initiates' regression would duplicate 'triggers'.

claims.summary: Test 2 (Delimiter Depth): provide [[TOKEN]] to exact_reference_delimiter_syntax (report cites L153) and confirm it respects MAX_EXACT_REFERENCE_DELIMITER_DEPTH (L151) of 4.
claims.disposition: verified_existing. exact_reference_delimiter_syntax saturates reported depth via .take(MAX) (L208, L213). Her exact [[<end_of_turn>]] -> depth 2 is pinned by exact_reference_delimiter_syntax_reports_double_square_bracket_depth_two (L3226); four-level by reports_exact_four_level_delimiter_depth (L2194); a 5-level [[[[[<end_of_turn>]]]]] bounded to the constant by bounds_homogeneous_square_bracket_stack_beyond_max_depth (L2301) and bounds_deeper_delimiter_receipt (L2288). All pass.

claims.summary: Suggested Next: verify how sanitize_model_control_markers_with_report (L352) handles a marker detected but failing the syntax check.
claims.disposition: verified_existing. Complete read of L352-517: markers with reference_syntax None are counted per-token into removed_tokens (filter L367-374), stripped from result via scan (L129), and each emits a none_cleanup_candidate context receipt (L309); preserved counts (quoted/grouped/explicit) are tallied separately (L392-449). This detected-but-failed path is asserted by distinguishes_allowlisted_is_from_unlisted_acts (L2603) and triggers (L2881).

claims.summary: Citation location: report attributes exact_reference_delimiter_syntax to L153.
claims.disposition: verified_existing with a stated correction (not domesticated). At SHA 902a0358, L153 is exact_reference_delimiter_pair; exact_reference_delimiter_syntax is at L199. Both consult MAX_EXACT_REFERENCE_DELIMITER_DEPTH, so the depth-constraint claim is unaffected; only the line label is off by the sibling function. The functional behavior she named is grounded at L199-229.
